race.comment: PRETTY PERKY (4) could not have been more impressive when fresh from a spell last start over 1200m at this track, winding up from near the tail on the bend to score by a widening two lengths. Should relish the extra 200m so while this is a tougher race another win looks on the cards. ZARKANA (13) started favourite but gave away too much start last time out and finished third over 1200m at Balaklava. Far better placed out to this trip and with the run under the belt looms as a genuine threat. TERRITORIAN (6) returned to form recently when an eye-catching fifth over 1514m at Morphettville. Bolted in here at this trip three back. One of the key contenders. OUI FLOURISH (9) has switched from the Archibald stable to Jolly and Potter since finishing runner-up as favourite over 1300m at Goulburn six weeks ago. Tricky one to line up - respect any betting confidence. DIVERGENT (12) disappointed as public elect last start. A longer trip today might help.
